title: CORS reflects arbitrary Origin
recommendation: Validate the Origin against an allow-list; never reflect it blindly (especially with credentials).

title: Exposed .env configuration file
recommendation: Remove the file from the web root and rotate every credential it contains.

title: Exposed .git repository
recommendation: Block /.git at the web server and remove it from the web root; rotate any secrets it contained.

title: Cookie without HttpOnly flag
recommendation: Set HttpOnly so scripts cannot read session cookies.

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
recommendation: Define a Content-Security-Policy to limit script sources and reduce XSS impact.

title: Web service offered only over HTTP
evidence: port 8000 serves HTTP, no HTTPS port found

title: Exposed phpinfo() page
recommendation: Delete phpinfo pages from production servers.

title: Cookie without SameSite attribute
recommendation: Set SameSite=Lax or Strict to reduce CSRF risk.

title: Missing clickjacking protection
recommendation: Send X-Frame-Options or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.

title: Software version disclosed in HTTP headers
recommendation: Hide version details from Server / X-Powered-By; exact versions help attackers match known CVEs.

title: No security.txt published
recommendation: Publish /.well-known/security.txt so researchers know how to report issues.

title: robots.txt lists disallowed paths
recommendation: robots.txt is public; protect sensitive paths with authentication rather than hiding them.
